name: namao
description: Namão — lead discovery, enrichment and landing platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n platform,studio,runtime -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start:dev -w @namao/platform" "npm run dev -w @namao/studio" "npm run start:dev -w @namao/runtime"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @namao/landing-kit && npm run build -w @namao/platform && npm run build -w @namao/runtime && npm run build -w @namao/studio
scripts.test: npm run test -w @namao/platform && npm run test -w @namao/runtime
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @namao/platform && npm run test:e2e -w @namao/runtime
scripts.prisma:generate: npm run prisma:generate -w @namao/platform && npm run prisma:generate -w @namao/runtime
